summary: Nu-Med Plus, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of six gold mineral properties in Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, and Newfoundland, Canada, from MegumaGold Corp. and subsidiaries via its subsidiary Maritime Gold Corp. Consideration included 500,000 shares of Series A Preferred Stock and net smelter returns royalties. The transaction closed on August 20, 2026, after MegumaGold shareholder approval with 84.5% voting in favor. The deal was part of a previously disclosed property purchase agreement, also conditioned on Nu-Med's acquisition of Avid Gold. Watch for integration and operational updates on the newly acquired gold properties.
